title: HL HYPE Gold Stake Action Plan — Full ROI Analysis

executive_summary.critical_correction: K432 mandate assumed HYPE at ~$1.30 (Nov-2024 airdrop price). Actual price 2026-05-29 = $59.00 (45x higher). This completely changes the Gold tier ROI calculation.
executive_summary.k437_corrected_gold_roi_50m: 11.6% (based on $590K cost at $59/HYPE, higher volume tier)
executive_summary.mandate_error_reason: HYPE price 45x'd since the $1.30 estimate was formed
executive_summary.optimal_tier_recommendation: BRONZE (100 HYPE = $5,900 cost, 143.9% ROI at $10M AUM)
executive_summary.gold_tier_verdict: NOT RECOMMENDED at $10M AUM. Reconsider at $50M+ AUM where ROI = 11.6%.

hype_market_data.staking_apy_source: 2.26% at ~400M total HYPE staked (auto-compound, daily distribution)

staking_mechanics.mechanism: Delegate to validator via staking account (separate from spot account)
staking_mechanics.slashing_risk: NONE (no automatic slashing; jailing only for validator operational issues, not delegator)
staking_mechanics.auto_compound_mechanism: Rewards re-delegated automatically to staked validator every epoch (~90min)
staking_mechanics.minimum_stake: No minimum for delegators (validators need 10K HYPE self-delegation)
staking_mechanics.validator_commissions: Vary; commission increases capped unless new rate <= 1%
how_to_stake: 1. Transfer HYPE from spot account to staking account (instant)
3. Select validator (Foundation validators recommended for safety)
5. Fee discount activates within next trading session
6. Wait 7 days to unstake if needed

where_to_buy_hype.best_venue: HL spot (native, no transfer needed for staking)
where_to_buy_hype.transfer_if_external: Withdraw HYPE to HL wallet, then move to staking account

hl_fee_structure.note: Staking discount is multiplicative on top of volume tier fees. Stacking both provides compounding benefit.

immediate_action.rationale: Best ROI per dollar among tiers with meaningful absolute savings. 100 HYPE at $5,900 = trivial cost vs $10M AUM. Payback under 9 months.

scale_to_10m_aum.rationale: At $10M AUM, Gold ($590K stake) gives only 2.9% ROI — worse than parking funds in sUSDe (5%+ APY). Bronze dominates.

scale_to_50m_aum.note: At $50M AUM: Silver ROI = 87%, Gold ROI = 11.6%. Silver (1,000 HYPE = $59K) becomes attractive. Gold payback = 86.5 months — still suboptimal.

recommendation.gold_tier_trigger: Consider Gold only when AUM >= $100M (annual fee saving ~$136K+ vs $590K stake = ~23% ROI)

bronze_tier.verdict: ACCEPTABLE: annual benefit covers ~146% of stake cost. Only a >22% HYPE drop AND no recovery for 12 months causes a net loss.

gold_tier.verdict: HIGH RISK at $10M AUM: a 5.1% drop in HYPE erases 1 year of benefits. With HYPE at ATH, this is very plausible. NOT RECOMMENDED.

hedge_strategy.mechanism: Open 1x HYPE-USD short on HL perps
hedge_strategy.cost: ~1-3% annual funding rate (HYPE is typically slightly positive FR)
hedge_strategy.recommendation: For Bronze tier ($5,900 stake), hedge is optional (cost > benefit ratio unfavorable for small stake). For Silver+, hedge worth considering.

combined_with_k434_router.effect: Smart router (K434) routes K208 orders to HL when rebate conditions favor it. With HYPE staking active, HL becomes marginally more attractive (20% lower fees at Gold).
combined_with_k434_router.interaction: Compounding: higher HL volume → higher K208 HL leg → more fee savings from staking discount. Virtuous cycle if AUM scales.
combined_with_k434_router.at_bronze: Negligible routing effect change (10% discount is small at $10M)
combined_with_k434_router.at_gold_50m: Meaningful: 20% discount on larger HL volume makes HL routing score materially higher

procurement_playbook.step_1_buy: Buy 100 HYPE on HL spot (ticker: HYPE/USDC). Current price ~$59. Cost ~$5,900 for Bronze.
procurement_playbook.step_2_transfer: On HL dashboard: Transfer HYPE from Spot Account → Staking Account (instant, no fee)
procurement_playbook.step_3_delegate: Select validator on app.hyperliquid.xyz/staking. Foundation validators recommended. Delegate 100 HYPE.
procurement_playbook.step_4_verify: Check trading dashboard — fee tier should show 'Bronze' with 10% discount visible
procurement_playbook.step_5_wait: 1-day delegation lockup before undelegation possible; 7-day queue to move back to spot
procurement_playbook.step_6_monitor: Monthly check: confirm Bronze tier active, verify fee savings match expectations
procurement_playbook.unstake_procedure: 1) Undelegate on staking page → 2) After 1 day, initiate staking→spot transfer → 3) After 7 days, HYPE available in spot

action_8_corrected.label: HL HYPE Bronze stake (100 HYPE ≈ $5,900) — NOT Gold (cost corrected)
action_8_corrected.correction_note: K432 Gold ($13K) was based on $1.30/HYPE; actual price $59 = $590K for Gold. Bronze is optimal at $10M AUM.

current_aum_10m.do_not: Do NOT buy Gold tier (10,000 HYPE = $590,000 at $59/HYPE). ROI only 2.9%, HYPE risk high.

future_aum_50m.action: Upgrade to Silver when AUM reaches $50M. Cost $59K additional, $43.9K/yr incremental saving.

future_aum_100m_plus.rationale: At $100M+ AUM, HL annual volume ~$3.75B. Volume tier 3+. Fee saving at Gold = ~$68K × (100/10) = $680K+/yr vs $590K cost → ROI > 100%.

k432_correction_summary.root_cause: K432 used $1.30/HYPE (Nov 2024 airdrop price). HYPE traded 45x higher by May 2026.
k432_correction_summary.recommendation_change: Downgrade from Gold to Bronze tier. Save $584,100 in stake cost. Better ROI.
k432_correction_summary.annual_benefit_difference: $8,623/yr (Bronze) vs $30,314/yr (Gold) — Gold gives $21,691 more/yr but costs $584,100 more → marginal ROI 3.7%
